defects.what: The results (29, 24, £1,200k, 5 marks · £250k) are set in a small face at the foot of the tally; '£1.45M' never appears large on the stage and the mark tally at phone width is a thin strip
The hook frame is empty apart from the caption and the ledger; the Gantt only arrives in the commit beat
'82 hours of work.' sits alone for several seconds before the 46-week strip appears; fine as a beat, but the frame is mostly blank
Three stacked structures on one frame (Gantt, per-month mark columns, running tally) plus the legend; the eye has to find which one is the count

one_line: Counting the unearned months under three orders is the right mechanism and the arithmetic is clean; the results deserve the headline face, not the footnote face.
